description: Generate an API key to enable authenticated access to the Prometheus metrics endpoint.

keyGenerated.title: API Key Generated
keyGenerated.description: Copy this key now. It will not be shown again.

keyRemoved.title: API Key Removed
keyRemoved.description: The metrics endpoint is now disabled.

warning: This key will only be shown once. If you lose it, you must regenerate.

confirmReroll.title: Regenerate API Key?
confirmReroll.description: This will invalidate the current key. Any systems using the old key will lose access to the metrics endpoint.

confirmRemove.title: Remove API Key?
confirmRemove.description: This will disable the metrics endpoint. Prometheus scrapers will stop receiving data.

setupGuide.title: Prometheus Configuration
setupGuide.description: Add the following scrape job to your prometheus.yml:
setupGuide.bearerNote: Replace <YOUR_API_KEY> with the generated API key above.
setupGuide.grafanaDescription: In Grafana, add a Prometheus data source pointing to your Prometheus server (e.g. http://prometheus:9090). The metrics will be available automatically once Prometheus is scraping the endpoint above.

toggles.title: Per-subsystem timing metrics
toggles.description: Enable or disable timing instrumentation for individual subsystems. Disabling a subsystem stops emitting its histogram and counter series.
toggles.savedDescription: Metrics toggle updated. Changes apply within a few seconds.
toggles.errorDescription: Could not update the metrics toggle. Please try again.

http.label: HTTP request timing
http.description: Track per-route latency and request counts.

ws.label: WebSocket message timing
ws.description: Track per-event handler duration and connection lifetime.

cron.label: Cron job timing
cron.description: Track scheduled job duration and success/failure rate.

db.label: Database query timing
db.description: High cardinality — disabled by default. Enable only on installs with monitoring infrastructure that can absorb the extra series.

external.label: External call timing
external.description: Track SumUp, SMTP, MQTT, and other outbound integrations.

sse.label: Server-Sent Events
sse.description: Track active SSE connections, message rate, and connection lifetime.
